saints.name: St. Wenceslaus
saints.title: Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: The Christian duke of Bohemia, raised by his holy grandmother, murdered at the church door by his own brother…
biography: Wenceslaus (Václav), duke of Bohemia, was formed in the faith by his grandmother St. Ludmila and, on coming to power, ruled as a just and devout Christian prince, favouring the Church and the poor and seeking peace with his neighbours. His piety and his policy toward the Germans made him enemies among the nobles.

He was set upon and killed by his own brother Boleslaus and his followers at the door of a church about the year 935. Venerated at once as a martyr, he became the patron and heavenly prince of the Czech people, his memory carried across Christendom in song.
saints.knownFor: His just Christian rule and his martyrdom at his brother's hand.
